scripts.text:
[Killer]
Wh-what have
you done to me?!
C-can't... move!
scripts.translation:
[殺手]
你...你對我做了什麼？！
我...動不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh? I didn't expect
you to be able to cast
Close Confine so soon!
Amazing, just amazing!
Now, this is a good chance
for you to master the skill...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦？沒想到你能這麼快就使出緊密的約束！
太棒了，簡直太棒了！
現在，這是你掌握這項技能的好機會...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now pay attention.
I want you to practice
predicting your opponent's
movement intent on this killer.
You should be able to see which way he plans to move by his aura.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
現在集中注意力。
我要你在這個殺手身上練習預判對手的移動意圖。
你應該能通過他的靈氣看出他打算往哪個方向移動。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
If he plans to move to left,
his aura will be white. If he
moves to the right, it will be
yellow. If he intends to go
backward, it will be pale red.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
如果他打算向左移動，他的靈氣會是白色的。如果他向右移動，靈氣會是黃色的。如果他打算後退，靈氣會是淡紅色的。

scripts.text: Block him to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左攔截

scripts.text: Block him to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右攔截

scripts.text: Block his Retreat
scripts.translation: 攔截其撤退

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe killer remains
unable to move and looks
incredibly confused! Right
now, you're using the Close
Confine skill perfectly!^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF殺手依然無法移動，看起來非常困惑！
此刻，你完美地使用了緊密的約束！^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFWait--!
For some reason,
you sense that's not
the direction the killer
is moving at this moment.
You naturally correct yourself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF等等——！
不知為何，你感覺到殺手此刻並沒有朝那個方向移動。
你本能地修正了自己的判斷。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou successfully
retrieved the priceless
skill book written by the
legendary Chae Takbae.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你成功取回了傳奇人物蔡德培所寫的珍貴技能書。^000000

scripts.text:
[Killer]
Grrrrr...
S-still...
C-can't... Move!
scripts.translation:
[殺手]
嘎嘎嘎...
還...還是...
動...不了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm? Ah, amnesia as
resulting from transcending,
eh? Then I will teach you the
Close Confine skill once again.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯？啊，是因為超越導致的失憶症嗎？
那麼，我再教你一次緊密的約束。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
A Stalker, eh?
Make sure that you
use your abilities to
malign foes that deserve
to be stalked. Best of
luck to you, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
神行太保，是嗎？
請務必利用你的能力，去追蹤那些值得被追蹤的敵人。
祝你好運，冒險者。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎麼找到這個地方的？
我以為這個密室連流氓都進不來！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
這下糟了！
他們遲早會找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wh-who are you,
and how did you get
in here? Identify yourself!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是誰？
你是怎麼進來的？報上名來！

scripts.text: I don't mean you any harm!
scripts.translation: 我沒有惡意！

scripts.text: Give us what we want!
scripts.translation: 交出我們要的東西！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
No...?
Then... Then
why have you come?
It is no accident that
you have found me.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
沒有惡意？
那麼...那你為什麼來這裡？
你能找到我，絕非偶然。

scripts.text: I came to help you.
scripts.translation: 我是來幫你的

scripts.text: Oh, actually, I wasn't looking for you.
scripts.translation: 其實，我並不是在找你

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Stalker
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...好吧，我想我可以信任同為神行太保的你。
畢竟，盜賊之間也有義氣。
那麼，你聽說過蔡德培的傳說嗎？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmm... Well, I suppose
I can trust a fellow Rogue
with my predictament. Honor
among thieves and all that.
Alright. Have you ever heard
the legend of Chae Takbae?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...好吧，我想我可以信任同為流氓的你。
畢竟，盜賊之間也有義氣。
那麼，你聽說過蔡德培的傳說嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
100 years ago, Chae Takbae
was the very first person to
transcend his limits. He was
also the very person to choose
a different path, rather than the job order he previously had.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
100年前，蔡德培是第一個超越極限的人。
他也是第一個選擇不同道路，而非遵循原有職業順序的人。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
He was originally a Monk,
but after transcending, he
somehow became a Stalker.
Retaining his knowledge of
the Monk's Root skill, he adapted it for the purposes of the Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
他原本是武僧，但在超越之後，不知為何變成了神行太保。
他保留了武僧的真劍百破道技能知識，並將其改編用於流氓。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Chae Takbae recorded the
fundamentals for this new
Rogue skill in a book that
I was fortunate enough to
obtain. But as soon as I got
it, the blackmailing begain...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
蔡德培將這項新流氓技能的基礎記錄在一本書中，我有幸獲得了它。但就在我拿到書的那一刻，勒索就開始了...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
There are unscrupulous
parties that will use any
means to take the book away
from me. I can understand, as
my sons and I have learned new
skills from Takbae's writings.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
有一些不擇手段的人，會不惜一切代價從我手中奪走這本書。
我理解他們的動機，因為我和我的兒子們已經從德培的著作中學到了新技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
However, I am running
out of time and those men
will inevitably find me.
Will you help me save
myself and my sons?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
然而，我的時間不多了，那些人遲早會找到我。
你願意幫我救我和我兒子們嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，太感謝你了！
聽著，我不能冒險被找到，所以你能把這封信帶給我最小的兒子，^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000嗎？快一點，時間不多了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...我明白了。
但請想想，如果不是你，我還能信任誰來幫我呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Then you would know the
value of the skill book he has
written that I now possess.
However, I'm hounded by men
who will do anything to get it.
Would you please help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那麼你應該知道，他寫的那本技能書的價值，而我現在正持有它。
然而，我被那些不惜一切代價想要得到它的人追趕。
你能幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text: Sorry, but I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, thank you so much!
Listen, I can't risk being
found, so would you take
this letter to my youngest
son, ^FF0000Louis Greg^000000? Hurry,
there's not much time left!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，太感謝你了！
聽著，我不能冒險被找到，所以你能把這封信帶給我最小的兒子，^FF0000路易斯·格雷格^000000嗎？快一點，時間不多了！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I... I see.
But please realize
that, if not you, who
can I trust to help me?
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我...我明白了。
但請想想，如果不是你，我還能信任誰來幫我呢？

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...?
That seems unlikely, but
I suppose I better give you
the benefit of the doubt.
Well then, I hope that you
can find your way out of here.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...？
這似乎不太可能，但我想我還是應該給你一點信任。
那麼，我希望你能找到出路離開這裡。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
I see. So be it.
I'll show you the skill
that you covet so much...
^FF0000Close Confine^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我明白了。那就這樣吧。
我會展示你如此渴望的技能...
^FF0000緊密的約束^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hmpf. Now you are
helpless, allowing
me to do this: ^FF0000Back Stab^000000!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哼。現在你毫無還手之力，讓我來做這件事：^FF0000背刺^000000！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now get out of here.
Never show your greedy
face in front of me again.
And just be happy that
I haven't killed you!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
現在滾出去。
永遠不要再讓我看到你這貪婪的臉。
慶幸我沒有殺了你吧！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
We're running out of
time... Please bring this
letter to my youngest son,
^FF0000Louis^000000, as soon as you can!
You can find him in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Junior^000000.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
我們的時間不多了...
請儘快把這封信帶給我最小的兒子，^FF0000路易斯^000000！
你可以在^FF0000小霍爾格雷恩^000000附近的流氓公會找到他。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Louis sent you to find
^FF0000Thor^000000? He's in the Rogue
Guild near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000,
isn't he? I'm sorry that you
have to visit my sons one by
one... I know it's impractical.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
路易斯派你來找^FF0000索爾^000000？
他在^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000附近的流氓公會，對吧？很抱歉讓你不得不逐個拜訪我的兒子們...
我知道這很不方便。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, looking for ^FF0000Jay^000000, eh?
He's near ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here
in the Rogue Guild. Or at
least, he's usually there.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
啊，在找^FF0000傑伊^000000，是嗎？
他就在^FF0000小安東尼奧^000000附近的流氓公會。
至少，他通常都在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you're back!
And you've brought
a letter from Jay.
Good, good, let me
read what he has to say...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，你回來了！
而且你帶來了傑伊的信。
很好，很好，讓我看看他說了什麼...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Ah, great news! He's
contacted the Rogue Guild
to request extra protection
and to alert their guard. I can
finally relax just a little now. No one messes with Rogues.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
太好了！他聯絡了流氓公會，請求加強安保並通知衛兵。
我終於可以稍微放鬆一下了。
沒人敢惹流氓。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you very much for
your help. I would be in
hiding forever if it weren't
for you. In return, let me
offer you the chance to learn
Chae Takbae's secret skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
非常感謝你的幫助。
如果沒有你，我可能永遠都要躲藏起來了。
作為回報，讓我給你一次學習蔡德培秘密技能的機會。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please speak to ^FF0000Thor^000000
and tell him that I've
permitted you to learn
the skill I have taught
all of my sons. He'll
comply, I'm sure of it.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
請去和^FF0000索爾^000000對話，告訴他我允許你學習我教給所有兒子的技能。
我相信他會答應的。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please ask Thor to teach
you Chae Takbae's secret
Rogue skill. Understand that
I can't teach you this skill
with the equipment here in
this sloven panic room.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
請讓索爾教你蔡德培的秘密流氓技能。
請理解，我無法在這個雜亂無章的房間裡教你這個技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Hm...? Aren't you
supposed to be in the
middle of training to learn
that skill? Please speak to
Thor and complete your training.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
嗯...？你不應該正在訓練學習那個技能嗎？
請去和索爾對話，完成你的訓練。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
You've completed the
training? Ah, that's quite
exceptional. However, you
should speak to Thor first...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你完成了訓練？
啊，這相當出色。
不過，你應該先和索爾對話...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Oh, you've come back!
I hear that you've completed
the training and are ready
to hear about the applications
for the Close Confine skill.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哦，你回來了！
我聽說你已經完成了訓練，準備聽取關於緊密的約束技能的應用說明了。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Wah! What th--?!
Stop! P-please, stop
that man! We can't let
him steal that book!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
哇！什...什麼？！
住手！請...請阻止那個男子！我們不能讓他偷走那本書！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
That man just stole the
Close Confine skill book!
Please! Don't let him get
away! That book is priceless!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那個男子剛剛偷走了緊密的約束技能書！
請！別讓他逃了！
那本書是無價的！

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou returned the
skill book written by
Chae Takbae to Haijara.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你將蔡德培寫的技能書歸還給了海哈拉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thanks so much for your
assistance. Now, if you'd
like to know some detailed
information about Close
Confine, I can tell you more
about the skill if you like.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
非常感謝你的協助。
現在，如果你想知道關於緊密的約束的詳細資訊，我可以為你詳細介紹這個技能。

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
As you must know,
Close Confine immobilizes
an enemy that is very close
to you. However, there are
a few nuances regarding its
use on players or monsters.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
如你所知，緊密的約束會定住離你很近的敵人。
不過，在對玩家或魔物使用時有一些細微差別。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Now, Close Confine is
similar to the Monk's skill,
Root, but it only inhibits the
enemy's movement, not
its attack capabilities.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
現在，緊密的約束類似於武僧的技能真劍百破道，但它只限制敵人的移動，而不限制其攻擊能力。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of
Back Stab, which we can
only use once during Close
Confine's duration, we can
use any skill during the
Close Confine status.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
除了背刺在緊密的約束持續期間只能使用一次之外，我們可以在緊密的約束狀態下使用任何技能。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Enemies affected by
Close Confine can escape
by using Fly Wing, Butterfly
Wings, or the Teleport or
Hiding skills. However, only
Hiding is active during WoE.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
受到緊密的約束影響的敵人可以通過使用蒼蠅翅膀、蝴蝶翅膀，或瞬間移動或隱匿技能來逃脫。
不過，在攻城戰中只有隱匿有效。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Therefore, Close Confine
can be a very useful skill
during Guild War sieges, given
that the target doesn't use the
the Hiding skill to get away.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
因此，在攻城戰中，緊密的約束可以是一個非常有用的技能，前提是目標不使用隱匿技能逃跑。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
With the exception of Boss
monsters, Close Confine
will immobilize monsters for
10 seconds, giving Rogues
new possibilities when
hunting in a party.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
除了Boss魔物外，緊密的約束會將魔物定住10秒，為流氓在隊伍狩獵中提供新的可能性。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Well, that's all I can tell
you about Close Confine.
I hope that you can learn
more about this skill through
practice, and that you become as great a legend as Chae Takbae.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
好了，這就是我能告訴你的關於緊密的約束的一切。
我希望你能通過練習更多地瞭解這個技能，併成為像蔡德培一樣偉大的傳奇。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
All right then...
I hope that you can
learn more about Close
Confine through diligent
practice. Good luck, and
thanks again for your help.
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
那麼...
我希望你能通過勤奮的練習更多地瞭解緊密的約束。
祝你好運，再次感謝你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Thank you for helping
me protect this priceless
skill book. I hope that the
next time we meet, we'll be
comrades on the battlefield...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
謝謝你幫我保護這本無價的技能書。
我希望下次我們見面時，我們能在戰場上成為同志...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
H-how did you find this
place? I thought this panic
room was supposed to be
impenetrable, even by Rogues!
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
你...你是怎麼找到這個地方的？
我以為這個密室連流氓都進不來！

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
This can't be good!
It will only be a matter of
time before they find me...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
這下糟了！
他們遲早會找到我的...

scripts.text:
[Haijara Greg]
Please...
Find me a Stalker
or a Rogue that I can
trust and send him to
help me! I don't have 
much time left...
scripts.translation:
[海哈拉·格雷格]
拜託了...
請幫我找一位我信任的神行太保或流氓，讓他來幫我！
我剩下的時間不多了...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My father just...
He just vanished!
He was teaching me and
my brothers a new skill,
but lately he began acting
paranoid for some reason...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我父親剛剛...
他就這樣消失了！
他原本正在教我和兄弟們一項新技能，但最近他不知為何變得有些偏執...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Maybe he went into hiding?
I know there's a hidden panic
room in the Rogue Guild, but
even I don't know where to find
it. I hope everything's okay...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
也許他躲起來了？
我知道流氓公會裡有一個隱藏的密室，但我也不知道在哪裡。
希望他沒事...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Father did warn that
people might come after us
if they're learned about the
new skill we were learning.
Maybe he went into hiding in
the Rogue Guild's panic room...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
父親曾警告過，如果有人得知了我們正在學習的新技能，可能會找上門來。
也許他躲進了流氓公會的密室...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
What's this...?
A letter from my
father? Oh, he must
be alright! Quick, let
me read it right away!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
這是什麼...？
父親的信？
噢，他應該沒事！
快，讓我馬上讀一下！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh no, he may be safe for
now, but father is being hunted
by some dangerous people? My
brother Thor will want to know
about this. Let me write him
a letter really quickly...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
噢不，他現在可能安全，但父親正被一些危險的人追捕？
我哥哥索爾會想知道這件事的。讓我趕緊給他寫封信...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I know that I'm in no
position to ask any favors,
but I guess my father must
trust you. Please, would you
take my letter and deliver it
to my older brother, Thor?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我知道我沒有資格提出這樣的請求，但我父親一定很信任你。
拜託，你能收下這封信，並把它交給我哥哥索爾嗎？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You can find Thor
next to Hermanthorn Jr.
inside the Rogue Guild.
I'd really appreciate it if
you could help my family.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你可以在流氓公會裡，小赫曼索恩旁邊找到索爾。
如果你能幫幫我家人，我會非常感激的。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
My elder brother, ^FF0000Thor^000000,
must know about this right
away! Please bring him this
letter for me. He should be
near ^FF0000Hermanthorn Jr.^000000 here
inside the Rogue Guild.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我的哥哥，^FF0000索爾^000000，必須馬上知道這件事！
請把這封信帶給他。
他應該就在流氓公會裡，^FF0000小赫曼索恩^000000旁邊。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You're looking for my
brother, Jay? He's usually
hanging out here in the
Rogue Guild with Antonio Jr.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你在找我哥哥傑伊？
他通常都在流氓公會裡，和小安東尼奧混在一起。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
If you need to speak
to my father, he's still
probably in the hidden panic
room inside the Rogue Guild.
I still don't know where that
place could possibly be...
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
如果你需要和我父親對話，他可能還在流氓公會裡那個隱藏的密室中。
我到現在都不知道那個地方到底在哪裡...

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You want to learn the
secret Rogue skill? Oh,
you should probably talk
to ^FF0000Thor^000000 about that. I...
I'm really bad at explaining
things to people. Really bad.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你想學習流氓的秘密技能？噢，你最好去和^FF0000索爾^000000談談。
我...我真的很不擅長向別人解釋事情。真的不擅長。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Hm? You're in the middle
of learning the secret Rogue
skill, aren't you? Ooh, then
you're not supposed to be here
just yet. Please go back and
talk to ^FF0000Thor^000000 again, okay?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
嗯？你正在學習流氓的秘密技能，對吧？
噢，那你現在還不應該在這裡。
請回去再和^FF0000索爾^000000談談，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Oh, oh!
You're done with
the training? Ah,
then you need to
talk to Thor again!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
噢，噢！
你訓練完了？
啊，那你需要再去找索爾談談！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
You wanted to learn
more about Close Confine?
Ugh, then you better speak
to my father. I just learned
that skill myself, you know.
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
你想了解更多關於緊密的約束？
唉，那你最好去和我父親談談。
我自己也才剛學會這個技能，你知道的。

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
I just heard from my
brothers that Chae Takbae
developed Close Confine
as a way to brutally beat his
enemies, keeping them from
running away. Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我剛從兄弟們那裡聽說，蔡德培開發緊密的約束是為了殘酷地擊敗敵人，讓他們無法逃跑。
這是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Wow, you're really
great! I wish I were
as powerful as you.
I hate being a kid!
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
哇，你真的很厲害！
我希望我也能像你一樣強大。
我討厭當小孩！

scripts.text:
[Louis Greg]
Why'd I become a Rogue?
I guess I just like being
sneaky. That, and being
moral and law abiding is
just too tough, you know?
scripts.translation:
[路易斯·格雷格]
我為什麼成為流氓？
我想我只是喜歡偷偷摸摸的感覺。
而且，保持道德和遵紀守法實在太難了，你知道的？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Where did father go?
I hope those weird men
didn't get to him. With
any luck, he's hidden in
the panic room, but still...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
父親去哪裡了？
我希望那些怪人沒有抓到他。
運氣好的話，他躲在密室裡，但還是...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm... My father might
be hiding in the panic
room. I've never been able
to find it, but Markie says
that the entrance is cleverly
hidden to her left. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
嗯...我父親可能躲在密室裡。
我一直沒找到它，但馬基說入口巧妙地隱藏在她左邊。
嗯嗯...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Are you looking for
my little brother, ^FF0000Louis^000000?
Oh, he's always hanging
around that ^FF0000Hollgrehenn Jr.^000000
here in the Rogue Guild.
What did you need him for?
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
你在找我弟弟^FF0000路易斯^000000嗎？
哦，他總是在流氓公會裡和這裡的^FF0000小霍爾格雷恩^000000混在一起。
你找他有什麼事？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's this you're
giving me? A letter
from Louis? Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
你給我的這是什麼？
路易斯的信件？讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Oh God, father's in
serious trouble! I better
tell my older brother, Jay,
right away! Quick, find ^FF0000Jay^000000
next to ^FF0000Antonio Jr.^000000 here in
the guild! P-please hurry!
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
天哪，父親陷入大麻煩了！
我得馬上告訴我的哥哥傑伊！
快，去公會裡找^FF0000傑伊^000000，他就在^FF0000小安東尼奧^000000旁邊！
請...請快點！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You can find Jay hanging
out with Antonio Jr. here
inside the Rogue Guild. 
Please bring him the letter
I've written as soon as possible!
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
你可以在流氓公會裡找到傑伊，他正和小安東尼奧待在一起。
請儘快把我寫的這封信交給他！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hopefully, father hasn't
gone outside of the Rogue
Guild's panic room. That
may be the only place
where he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
希望父親沒有離開流氓公會的密室。
那裡可能是他唯一安全的地方...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
What's that? Father
wanted me to teach you
the secret Rogue skill?
Alright, I'll train you in the
same way father did. Would
you like an explanation first?
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
什麼？父親想讓我教你流氓的秘技？
好吧，我會像父親那樣訓練你。
你想先聽一下說明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
If you don't want an
explanation, I'll just
send you to the training
ground right away so that
you can learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
如果你不想聽說明，我就直接送你去訓練場，讓你學習^FF0000緊密的約束^000000。

scripts.text: Listen to Explanation
scripts.translation: 聽說明

scripts.text: Go to Training Ground
scripts.translation: 去訓練場

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
好的，學習^FF0000緊密的約束^000000的第一步是掌握阻擋敵人的移動。
我會送你去一個特殊的訓練場讓你練習。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
在那裡，你會遇到我們的訓練搭檔。靠近她，確保你能預判並阻擋她向左、向右或向後的移動。
準備好了，我現在就送你過去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, I'm going to break
the fourth wall here and assume
you were disconnected from the
game. Would you like to return
to the training ground in order
to learn ^FF0000Close Confine^000000?
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
好吧，我要打破第四面牆了，假設你剛才斷線了。
你想回到訓練場繼續學習^FF0000緊密的約束^000000嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 是的，請

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, the very first step
to learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000
is to master blocking your
enemy's movement. I'll send
you to a special training
ground so you can practice.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
好的，學習^FF0000緊密的約束^000000的第一步是掌握阻擋敵人的移動。
我會送你去一個特殊的訓練場讓你練習。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
There, you'll encounter our
training partner. Approach her
closely and make sure that you
predict and block her movements
to the left, right or backward. Get ready, I'm sending you now...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
在那裡，你會遇到我們的訓練搭檔。靠近她，確保你能預判並阻擋她向左、向右或向後的移動。
準備好了，我現在就送你過去...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Alright, alright.
When you feel ready
to resume training,
just let me know.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
好的，好的。
當你準備好繼續訓練時，告訴我一聲。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Ah, I hear from Kienna
that you've completed your
training. Congratulations!
Now, please speak to my
father so that he can explain the Close Confine skill in detail.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
啊，我從基恩娜那裡聽說你完成了訓練。恭喜！
現在，請去和我的父親對話，讓他詳細解釋緊密的約束這個技能。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Please talk to my father
so that he can explain the
nuances of the Close Confine
skill to you. He should still be in the Rogue Guild's panic room.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
請和我的父親對話，讓他向你解釋緊密的約束技能的細節。他應該還在流氓公會的密室裡。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
You know, Chae Takbae
would say, ''I'm Chae
Takbae. And you are...?''
to opponents, and right
before they could answer,
he'd beat them to a pulp.
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
你知道嗎，蔡德培會對對手說：
“我是蔡德培。而你是...？”
就在對方還沒來得及回答之前，他就把對方打得落花流水。

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
He really is
a legendary hero
amongst Rogues...!
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
他真的是流氓中的傳奇英雄...！

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hm...?
It seems that
you're much stronger
than even me. There's
probably not too many
people who'd mess with you...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
嗯...？
看來你比我強多了。
大概沒多少人敢招惹你...

scripts.text:
[Thor Greg]
Hmm, gank this, gank
that. *Sigh* It's my most
shameful fault: I spend zeny
almost as quickly as I can
steal it. It's irresponsible...
scripts.translation:
[索爾·格雷格]
嗯，搶這個，搶那個。
*嘆氣* 這是我最大的恥辱：我花錢的速度幾乎和偷竊的速度一樣快。真是不負責任...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
My father must be hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. Strangely, my brothers
and I can never find it and
figure out whether he's safe...
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
父親一定躲在流氓公會的密室裡。
奇怪的是，我和兄弟們總是找不到它，也不知道他是否安全...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Recently, he's been pursued
by these strange men who've
been threatening our family.
Well, he did just teach us
a new skill, so he can use
that to protect himself...
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
最近，他一直被一些奇怪的男人追趕，他們威脅著我們的家族。
不過，他剛教了我們一個新技能，所以他應該能用來自保...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I'm guessing my father
hid himself in the Rogue
Guild's panic room. We can
never find it, but supposedly
the entrance is hidden close
to Markie somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
我猜父親是躲在流氓公會的密室裡。
我們總是找不到它，但據說入口就在馬基附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You're looking for
Louis, my little brother?
He's here in the Rouge Guild,
so it shouldn't be too hard to
find him. He's probably just
standing near Hollgrehen Jr.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
你在找我弟弟路易斯？
他就在流氓公會裡，應該不難找到。
他大概正站在小霍爾格雷恩附近。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Thor? He should be
around the Rogue Guild
somewhere. Have you tried
looking around Hermathorn Jr.?
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
索爾？他應該在流氓公會附近。
你試過在小赫曼索恩附近找找嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
A letter for me...?
Ah, it's from Thor, so
I guess I better read
it right away. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
給我的信...？
啊，是索爾寄來的，看來我得馬上讀一下。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I see... I must report
this to the Rogue Guild
right away, and send a reply
to my father. Hmm. Let me
write him a letter right now.
Please give me a moment...
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
我明白了...我必須立刻向流氓公會報告，並給父親回信。嗯。讓我現在就寫。
請給我一點時間...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
There, it's done. Please
give this to my father with
all the haste you can muster.
I know it's much to ask, but
I cannot find the way to the
hidden panic room myself...
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
好了，寫完了。請儘可能快地把這封信交給我的父親。
我知道這要求有點過分，但我自己找不到通往密室的路...

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Please give my reply
to my father as soon as
you can. He's still hidden
in the Rogue Guild's panic
room. That is, if our enemies
still haven't found him yet.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
請儘快把我的回信交給父親。
他還躲在流氓公會的密室裡。
也就是說，如果我們的敵人還沒找到他的話。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
你需要練習“緊密的約束”技能？
我想只有索爾有許可權使用訓練場，所以請先去和他談談。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
You need to train for
the Close Confine skill?
I think Thor is the only
one with access to the
training ground, so
talk to him first.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
你需要練習“緊密的約束”技能？
我想只有索爾有許可權使用訓練場，所以請先去和他談談。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ah, you finished the
training for Close Confine,
did you? Great, now go and
tell my brother, Thor.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
啊，你已經完成了“緊密的約束”的練習？
很好，現在去告訴我弟弟索爾吧。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Hm. You should probably
talk to my father to learn
more of the nuances about
the Close Confine skill.
Have you seen him in the
Rogue Guild's panic room?
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
嗯。你最好和我父親談談，瞭解更多關於“緊密的約束”的細節。
你在流氓公會的密室裡見過他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Chae Takbae sure
seemed like a stubborn,
thuggish guy. But he must
have been pretty smart to
invent some of his own skills.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
蔡德培看起來確實是個固執、粗魯的傢伙。但他一定很聰明，才能發明出一些自己的技能。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
I get the feeling
that you're going to
be one of the best Rogues
around, if you already aren't.
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
我感覺你將成為最厲害的流氓之一，如果你現在還不是的話。

scripts.text:
[Jay Greg]
Ever since I learned
Intimdate, I've gotten
real punchy, maybe even
masochistic. I mean, if they
hit you with a skill, you can
hit them back with it!
scripts.translation:
[傑伊·格雷格]
自從學會了“抄襲”，我就變得很有攻擊性，甚至有點受虐傾向。
我是說，如果他們用技能打你，你也可以用同樣的技能反擊！

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, in this
exercise, you'll need
to predict which way I'm
going to move and block
me from moving, essentially
immobilizing me. Get ready~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
好了，在這個練習中，你需要預判我要往哪個方向移動，並阻止我移動，基本上就是讓我無法動彈。準備好了~

scripts.text: Block her to the Left
scripts.translation: 向左阻擋

scripts.text: Block her to the Right
scripts.translation: 向右阻擋

scripts.text: Block her retreat
scripts.translation: 阻擋退路

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Huh...?
You blocked me!
Very nice work~
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
咦...？
你擋住我了！
做得非常好~

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Sorry, but I wasn't
moving in that direction.
Your block attempt failed...
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
抱歉，但我並沒有往那個方向移動。
你的阻擋失敗了...

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Alright, we're done
here. You earned a
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
I'm happy to say that
you've completed your
training! Let me send
you back to Thor Greg
now so that you can finish
learning ^FF0000Close Confine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]

現在讓我把你送回索爾·格雷格那裡，這樣你就可以完成^FF0000緊密的約束^000000的學習了。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
Hm. With this grade,
I don't think you're
quite ready to finish
learning Close Confine.
Would you like to try the
training exercise again?
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
嗯。以這個成績，我認為你還沒有準備好完成緊密的約束的學習。
你想再嘗試一次訓練嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 帶了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
You must have canceled
your training in the middle
of the exercise. I'm sorry,
but you'll have to start
from the very beginning
of this training.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
你肯定是在訓練中途取消了。
很抱歉，你必須從這項訓練的最開始重新來過。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
You've already completed
the training exercise for
the Close Confine skill.
You no longer have need
for my assistance.
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
你已經完成了緊密的約束技能的訓練。
你不再需要我的幫助了。

scripts.text:
[Kienna]
I'm sorry, but I don't
think you belong here.
Let me send you to the
Rogue Guild if you're lost...
scripts.translation:
[基恩娜]
很抱歉，但我覺得你不屬於這裡。
如果你迷路了，讓我把你送到流氓公會去吧...
